input: Research local indoor climbing gyms nearby

gold.taskTitle: Research indoor climbing gyms near you
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate local indoor climbing gyms in the user's area.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the search cover?
questions.description: Identify the specific location to focus the gym search on.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to a gym?
questions.description: Determine the maximum acceptable distance or travel time.

questions.title: What is your current climbing experience level?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a beginner, intermediate, or advanced climber.

questions.title: Which climbing styles are you most interested in?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants bouldering, top rope, lead climbing, or a mix.

questions.title: Do you need rental gear or a beginner intro course?
questions.description: Determine if the user needs gyms that offer equipment rentals or introductory programs.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for a membership or day pass?
questions.description: Clarify the user's spending limits to filter gym options by cost.

questions.title: Are you going solo or looking to bring others along?
questions.description: Understand whether this is an individual or group activity, which may affect gym choice.
